claim_one_line: THE CROSSINGS CENSUS (a census arc, the owner's question 2026-10-13): no crossing from the principle's mathematics to a physical number has succeeded -- B915 (15.97 sigma), B925, B929 (shape hit, value miss), B1005 (Tier 2 fired), B1027 with B1063 (all miss), B856 and B1066 (golden-ratio mixing excluded at 4.7 sigma) -- and every one identified an object's number with a physical one by fiat (I-13 unearned); none crossed through a field.
